author: mark
text:
Harness neutral adapter-wire types in src/provider/wire.rs

Decouples the lernie crate from lernie-provider-anthropic at the
library level. The harness parses adapter stdout into
crate::provider::wire::Response per ARCH §4.4's non-streaming shape,
so out-of-tree adapters do not take lernie-provider-anthropic as a
transitive dep. Binary invocation still bridges the two via exec.

Types mirror §4.4 required fields: id, model, stop_reason, content[],
usage { input_tokens, output_tokens }. Unknown content-block types
parse as ContentBlock::Unknown; unknown usage fields (Anthropic-native
cache names) are accepted and ignored. A text() helper concatenates
Text blocks for response.json's assistant_response.

Coverage stays at 100% (1315/1315). Unit tests in wire.rs cover the
happy shape, text() with mixed blocks, unknown cache fields, and every
required-field rejection; prompt::tests::errors_parse already transits
this type, pinning the full negative matrix end-to-end.
